decisions.value: CatchHole `/landing` is the public marketing surface for web-novel authors and editors evaluating a product that turns uploaded episode manuscripts into AI-extracted character and world-setting candidates with source evidence and author confirmation. This contract applies only to the landing surface.

value: Experience the manuscript-to-setting review flow without signing in through `/demo` as the primary landing conversion.
Move to free sign-up as the secondary path when ready to register a work and use the full service.
Make reference-led landing redesigns visibly distinct through a strong first-screen hero and meaningful section hierarchy; CTA styling alone is not sufficient.
Use purpose-built, visually distinct images for the hero and each product-flow panel instead of reusing one generic image through repeated crops.
Present the implemented eight-stage manuscript workflow as one animated exploratory accordion with a clear active step and reduced-motion fallback.
Present the product capability surface as a structured two-column service catalog on desktop and a single-column catalog on mobile.

color.control-border.$description: Verified NHN Cloud resource-control border evidence.

color.menu-surface.$description: Reference-only dark expanded menu surface; do not generalize it into the CatchHole workspace palette.

color.menu-text.$description: Reference-only text color on the dark expanded menu surface.

assets.notes: Corporate marketing reference use is verified; upstream Pretendard is distributed under SIL Open Font License 1.1.
One dedicated hero composition and eight purpose-built workflow panel images created for CatchHole.

roles.usage: Hero and major landing section headings with a compact, high-impact hierarchy.
Landing navigation, CTA, product-step labels, catalog titles, and supporting copy.

rules: Use the landing display role for first-screen impact and the landing UI role for compact product explanation.
Keep image purpose explicit: the hero explains manuscript-to-setting connection, while each workflow image represents one distinct product stage.

disabled.reason: The public demo route is always available from the landing page.

error.reason: Route-level failures are not rendered as a button state.

loading.reason: Navigation does not expose an asynchronous loading state in this control.

success.reason: Successful navigation replaces the landing route instead of changing the button state.

value.semantics: Navigates directly to the login-free interactive demo and remains the primary landing conversion.

error.reason: The showcase does not call product APIs.

loading.reason: All panel assets are bundled with the landing page.

success.reason: Selecting a step is represented by the expanded state.

value.semantics: Explores the real eight-stage CatchHole workflow within one showcase instead of displaying eight isolated screens.
variants: tablet and mobile horizontal step strip

decisions.value: Use `로그인 없이 체험하기` as the primary action in the header, hero, and closing CTA; free sign-up remains secondary.

rules: Support 320px-wide viewports and reflow at 200% zoom without horizontal scrolling.
Keep the primary CTA reachable before the showcase and again after the service catalog.
Keep a strong split hero at wide viewports, then stack copy before imagery on narrower screens without horizontal overflow.
Render the service catalog in two columns on desktop and one column on mobile, preserving the same capability order and upcoming labels.
Reformat the eight-step desktop accordion into a single active panel with a horizontal step strip on tablet and mobile.
Keep CTA labels short and action-oriented.
Mark unshipped capabilities with `업데이트 예정` and do not present them as currently available.

voice: Write Korean landing copy in a direct, capability-led style that explains what the author can inspect, compare, or confirm.
Use concrete product nouns such as 원고, 회차, 캐릭터, 세계관, 원문 근거, and 설정 이력 instead of abstract AI claims.

value: Direct project-owner instructions for the requested landing scope.
CatchHole repository facts and verified implementation behavior.
NHN Cloud reference inspiration within its captured evidence boundary.
